fields.title: Cluster count
fields.description: Comma-separated list defining the number of clusters to generate in each universe (e.g., "2, 3" creates 2 clusters in the first universe and 3 in the second).

fields.title: Universe sizes
fields.description: Comma-separated list specifying the number of attributes (dimensions) for each universe (e.g., "2, 3" means first universe has 2 attributes, second has 3).

fields.title: Pattern count
fields.description: Total number of data patterns to generate across all clusters and universes.

fields.title: Standard deviation
fields.description: Controls the spread of data points within each cluster. Smaller values create tighter clusters.

fields.title: Noise fraction
fields.description: Proportion of randomly distributed data points that don't belong to any cluster. Value between 0 (no noise) and 1 (all noise).

fields.title: Random seed
fields.description: Fixed value to ensure reproducible data generation. Use the same seed to generate identical datasets.
